en.title: Milton Leite is target of operation against PCC infiltration in transportation
en.summary: Milton Leite is the subject of an investigation targeting alleged infiltration by the PCC criminal organization in the transportation sector.

stories.title: Operação do Ministério Público mira Milton Leite, ex-presidente da Câmara de São Paulo

en.title: Public Ministry Operation Targets Milton Leite, Former President of São Paulo City Council
en.summary: A public ministry and civil police operation targeted Milton Leite, a former São Paulo city council president and seven-term councilman from 1997 to 2024. He is among those subject to a 30-day temporary arrest warrant authorized by São Paulo's Court of Justice.

stories.title: Quem é Milton Leite, ex-presidente da Câmara de SP alvo de operação que investiga infiltração do PCC

en.title: Who is Milton Leite, Former São Paulo City Council President Targeted in Operation Investigating PCC Infiltration
en.summary: Milton Leite, a União Brasil politician, served 27 years in São Paulo's municipal council from 1997 to 2024 and presided over the legislature four times. Now 70, he began his political career in 1990 and built his primary electoral base in the city's South Zone.

stories.title: Polícia considera Milton Leite foragido em operação contra infiltração do PCC no transporte de SP

en.title: Police Consider Milton Leite a Fugitive in Operation Against PCC Infiltration in São Paulo Transportation
en.summary: São Paulo police consider former councilman and ex-city council president Milton Leite a fugitive in Operation Vectura Corrupta targeting PCC infiltration in public administration and public transportation. Police did not locate him when executing the arrest warrant at his residence.

stories.title: Chuva perde força no Vale do Paraíba e Litoral Norte, mas previsão ainda é de tempo instável nesta quinta-feira

en.title: Rain Loses Strength in Paraíba Valley and North Coast, but Unstable Weather Still Forecast for Thursday
en.summary: Rainfall is weakening in São Paulo's Paraíba Valley and North Coast region, though unstable conditions persist through Thursday. Sunshine will appear during the day with increasing clouds in the afternoon due to ocean winds, and light rain or drizzle remains possible in coastal areas.

stories.title: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro Head Into Brazil’s Tied 2026 Presidential Vote

en.title: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro Head Into Brazil's Tied 2026 Presidential Vote
en.summary: Brazil will hold its presidential election on 4 October 2026, with President Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro leading in polls. A runoff between the top two candidates is scheduled for 25 October if no candidate wins a majority of valid votes among approximately 158.7 million registered voters.

stories.title: São Paulo deve ter quinta de frio e céu nublado; tempo melhora na sexta, mostra previsão

en.title: São Paulo to have cold Thursday and cloudy sky; weather improves Friday, forecast shows
en.summary: São Paulo state is expected to experience low temperatures and overcast conditions on Thursday with isolated rainfall possible in some areas. Weather conditions are forecast to improve on Friday with decreased instability.

en.title: CLOSING: Asian stock markets end mixed after Fed interest rate increase
en.summary: Asian stock exchanges showed mixed results following Wall Street's decline, which was triggered by the Federal Reserve's decision to raise interest rates for the first time in three years.
